Parts#

The following classes allow interaction with a vessel’s individual parts.

See also

The parts guide walks the tree of parts, and explains fuel lines, stage numbers and part modules.

Parts#

class SpaceCenter.Parts()#

Instances of this class are used to interact with the parts of a vessel. An instance can be obtained by calling SpaceCenter.Vessel.getParts().

Parts.getAll()#

A list of all of the vessels parts.

Property:

Read-only, cannot be set

Return type:

Array of SpaceCenter.Part

Parts.getRoot()#

The vessels root part.

Property:

Read-only, cannot be set

Return type:

SpaceCenter.Part

Note

See the discussion on Traversing the Tree.

Parts.getControlling()#
Parts.setControlling(value)#

The part from which the vessel is controlled. Returns null if the vessel has no control point, in which case it is oriented by its root part.

Property:

Can be read or written

Return type:

SpaceCenter.Part or null

Game Scenes:

Flight

Note

A vessel gets no control point when it is created by a decoupler or an undocking and none of its parts is a command module with crew aboard. A probe core does not give it one either. Assign this property to choose the control point, which is equivalent to “Control From Here” in game.

Parts.withName(name)#

A list of parts whose SpaceCenter.Part.getName() is name.

Arguments:

  • name (string) – The name of the part.

Return type:

Array of SpaceCenter.Part

Parts.withTitle(title)#

A list of all parts whose SpaceCenter.Part.getTitle() is title.

Arguments:

  • title (string) – The title of the part.

Return type:

Array of SpaceCenter.Part

Parts.withTag(tag)#

A list of all parts whose SpaceCenter.Part.getTag() is tag.

Arguments:

  • tag (string) – The name tag of the part.

Return type:

Array of SpaceCenter.Part

Parts.withModule(moduleName)#

A list of all parts that contain a SpaceCenter.Module whose SpaceCenter.Module.getName() is moduleName.

Arguments:

  • moduleName (string) – The name of the module.

Return type:

Array of SpaceCenter.Part

Parts.modulesWithName(moduleName)#

A list of modules (combined across all parts in the vessel) whose SpaceCenter.Module.getName() is moduleName.

Arguments:

  • moduleName (string) – The name of the module.

Return type:

Array of SpaceCenter.Module

Parts.getAntennas()#

A list of all antennas in the vessel.

Property:

Read-only, cannot be set

Return type:

Array of SpaceCenter.Antenna

Note

A part with several antennas has an entry for each. If RemoteTech is installed, this will always return an empty list. To interact with RemoteTech antennas, use the RemoteTech service APIs.

Parts.getCargoBays()#

A list of all cargo bays in the vessel.

Property:

Read-only, cannot be set

Return type:

Array of SpaceCenter.CargoBay

Parts.getControlSurfaces()#

A list of all control surfaces in the vessel.

Property:

Read-only, cannot be set

Return type:

Array of SpaceCenter.ControlSurface

Parts.getDecouplers()#

A list of all decouplers in the vessel.

Property:

Read-only, cannot be set

Return type:

Array of SpaceCenter.Decoupler

Parts.getDockingPorts()#

A list of all docking ports in the vessel.

Property:

Read-only, cannot be set

Return type:

Array of SpaceCenter.DockingPort

Parts.getEngines()#

A list of all engines in the vessel.

Property:

Read-only, cannot be set

Return type:

Array of SpaceCenter.Engine

Note

This includes any part that generates thrust. This covers many different types of engine, including liquid fuel rockets, solid rocket boosters, jet engines and RCS thrusters.

Parts.getExperiments()#

A list of all science experiments in the vessel.

Property:

Read-only, cannot be set

Return type:

Array of SpaceCenter.Experiment

Parts.getFairings()#

A list of all fairings in the vessel.

Property:

Read-only, cannot be set

Return type:

Array of SpaceCenter.Fairing

Parts.getIntakes()#

A list of all intakes in the vessel.

Property:

Read-only, cannot be set

Return type:

Array of SpaceCenter.Intake

Parts.getLegs()#

A list of all landing legs attached to the vessel.

Property:

Read-only, cannot be set

Return type:

Array of SpaceCenter.Leg

Parts.getLaunchClamps()#

A list of all launch clamps attached to the vessel.

Property:

Read-only, cannot be set

Return type:

Array of SpaceCenter.LaunchClamp

Parts.getLights()#

A list of all lights in the vessel.

Property:

Read-only, cannot be set

Return type:

Array of SpaceCenter.Light

Parts.getParachutes()#

A list of all parachutes in the vessel.

Property:

Read-only, cannot be set

Return type:

Array of SpaceCenter.Parachute

Parts.getRadiators()#

A list of all radiators in the vessel.

Property:

Read-only, cannot be set

Return type:

Array of SpaceCenter.Radiator

Parts.getResourceDrains()#

A list of all resource drains in the vessel.

Property:

Read-only, cannot be set

Return type:

Array of SpaceCenter.ResourceDrain

Parts.getRCS()#

A list of all RCS blocks/thrusters in the vessel.

Property:

Read-only, cannot be set

Return type:

Array of SpaceCenter.RCS

Parts.getReactionWheels()#

A list of all reaction wheels in the vessel.

Property:

Read-only, cannot be set

Return type:

Array of SpaceCenter.ReactionWheel

Parts.getResourceConverters()#

A list of all resource converters in the vessel.

Property:

Read-only, cannot be set

Return type:

Array of SpaceCenter.ResourceConverter

Parts.getResourceHarvesters()#

A list of all resource harvesters in the vessel.

Property:

Read-only, cannot be set

Return type:

Array of SpaceCenter.ResourceHarvester

Parts.getRoboticControllers()#

A list of all robotic controllers in the vessel.

Property:

Read-only, cannot be set

Return type:

Array of SpaceCenter.RoboticController

Parts.getRoboticHinges()#

A list of all robotic hinges in the vessel.

Property:

Read-only, cannot be set

Return type:

Array of SpaceCenter.RoboticHinge

Parts.getRoboticPistons()#

A list of all robotic pistons in the vessel.

Property:

Read-only, cannot be set

Return type:

Array of SpaceCenter.RoboticPiston

Parts.getRoboticRotations()#

A list of all robotic rotations in the vessel.

Property:

Read-only, cannot be set

Return type:

Array of SpaceCenter.RoboticRotation

Parts.getRoboticRotors()#

A list of all robotic rotors in the vessel.

Property:

Read-only, cannot be set

Return type:

Array of SpaceCenter.RoboticRotor

Parts.getSensors()#

A list of all sensors in the vessel.

Property:

Read-only, cannot be set

Return type:

Array of SpaceCenter.Sensor

Parts.getSolarPanels()#

A list of all solar panels in the vessel.

Property:

Read-only, cannot be set

Return type:

Array of SpaceCenter.SolarPanel

Parts.getWheels()#

A list of all wheels in the vessel.

Property:

Read-only, cannot be set

Return type:

Array of SpaceCenter.Wheel

Part#

class SpaceCenter.Part()#

Represents an individual part. Vessels are made up of multiple parts. Instances of this class can be obtained by several methods in SpaceCenter.Parts.

Part.getName()#

Internal name of the part, as used in part cfg files. For example “Mark1-2Pod”.

Property:

Read-only, cannot be set

Return type:

string

Part.getTitle()#

Title of the part, as shown when the part is right clicked in-game. For example “Mk1-2 Command Pod”.

Property:

Read-only, cannot be set

Return type:

string

Part.getConfig()#

The static configuration of the part, as found in its part cfg file. This provides access to data that is not exposed elsewhere, such as the configuration of the part’s modules. Returns null if the part has no associated configuration node.

Property:

Read-only, cannot be set

Return type:

SpaceCenter.ConfigNode

Part.getTag()#
Part.setTag(value)#

The name tag for the part. Can be set to a custom string using the in-game user interface. Throws an exception if no name tag part module is installed.

Property:

Can be read or written

Return type:

string

Note

Requires KSPCommunityPartModules 0.5 or later, or kOS, which share one name tag.

Part.getFlagURL()#
Part.setFlagURL(value)#

The asset URL for the part’s flag.

Property:

Can be read or written

Return type:

string

Part.getHighlighted()#
Part.setHighlighted(value)#

Whether the part is highlighted.

Property:

Can be read or written

Return type:

boolean

Game Scenes:

Flight

Note

The highlighting is removed when the client that enabled it disconnects.

Part.getHighlightColor()#
Part.setHighlightColor(value)#

The color used to highlight the part.

Property:

Can be read or written

Return type:

StdLib.ColorRGB

Game Scenes:

Flight

Part.getCost()#

The cost of the part with its resources full, in units of funds.

Property:

Read-only, cannot be set

Return type:

number

Part.getVessel()#

The vessel that contains this part.

Property:

Read-only, cannot be set

Return type:

Flight, Editor Vab, Editor Sph

Flight

Note

The game sets this high on splashdown and eases it down as the part moves through the water. It climbs back once the part slows to a crawl, so a hull under way reads lower than one lying still.

The multiplier applied to the lift on the part while it is submerged.

The crash tolerance of the part, in \(\mathrm{m/s}\).

Property:

Read-only, cannot be set

Return type:

number

Part.getBreakingForce()#

The breaking force of the part’s attachments, in \(\mathrm{kN}\).

Property:

Read-only, cannot be set

Return type:

number

Game Scenes:

Flight, Editor Vab, Editor Sph

Note

The joint to the parent part takes the lower breaking force of the two parts, scaled by the size of the attachment node. See SpaceCenter.Part.getJointBreakForce().

Part.getBreakingTorque()#

The breaking torque of the part’s attachments, in \(\mathrm{kN \cdot m}\).

Property:

Read-only, cannot be set

Return type:

number

Game Scenes:

Flight, Editor Vab, Editor Sph

Note

The joint to the parent part takes the lower breaking torque of the two parts, scaled by the size of the attachment node. See SpaceCenter.Part.getJointBreakTorque().

Part.getJointBreakForce()#

The force that breaks the joint to the parent part, in \(\mathrm{kN}\). Throws an exception if the part has no joint to its parent part.

Property:

Read-only, cannot be set

Return type:

number

Game Scenes:

Flight

Note

The sum over the joint’s physics joints. It is infinite for a short time after the vessel loads, such as just after launch. The root part and a physicsless part have no joint to their parent.

Part.getJointBreakTorque()#

The torque that breaks the joint to the parent part, in \(\mathrm{kN \cdot m}\). Throws an exception if the part has no joint to its parent part.

Property:

Read-only, cannot be set

Return type:

number

Game Scenes:

Flight

Note

The sum over the joint’s physics joints. It is infinite for a short time after the vessel loads. On a stack node of size 2 or more, the physics joints sit apart around the node. A bending moment then breaks the joint when one physics joint’s force exceeds its share of SpaceCenter.Part.getJointBreakForce(), usually at a much larger moment than this torque.

Part.getJointSpring()#

The spring constant of the joint to the parent part against translation, in \(\mathrm{kN/m}\). Throws an exception if the part has no joint to its parent part.

Property:

Read-only, cannot be set

Return type:

number

Game Scenes:

Flight

Note

The sum over the joint’s physics joints. A rigid attachment locks the joint, and this spring then has no effect.

Part.getJointDamper()#

The damping constant of the joint to the parent part against translation, in \(\mathrm{kN \cdot s/m}\). Throws an exception if the part has no joint to its parent part.

Property:

Read-only, cannot be set

Return type:

number

Game Scenes:

Flight

Note

The sum over the joint’s physics joints. The stock game sets it to zero, and mods such as Kerbal Joint Reinforcement change it.

Part.getJointAngularSpring()#

The spring constant of the joint to the parent part against bending, in \(\mathrm{kN \cdot m/rad}\). Throws an exception if the part has no joint to its parent part.

Property:

Read-only, cannot be set

Return type:

number

Game Scenes:

Flight

Note

The sum over the joint’s physics joints, about the two axes perpendicular to the joint axis. The joint is far stiffer against twisting about its axis. On a stack node of size 2 or more, the physics joints sit apart around the node, and the joint bends much less than this spring gives. A rigid attachment makes it infinite.

Part.getJointAngularDamper()#

The damping constant of the joint to the parent part against bending, in \(\mathrm{kN \cdot m \cdot s/rad}\). Throws an exception if the part has no joint to its parent part.

Property:

Read-only, cannot be set

Return type:

number

Game Scenes:

Flight

Note

The sum over the joint’s physics joints. The stock game sets it to zero, and mods such as Kerbal Joint Reinforcement change it.

Part.position(referenceFrame)#

The position of the part in the given reference frame.

Arguments:

  • referenceFrame (SpaceCenter.ReferenceFrame) – The reference frame that the returned position vector is in.

Returns:

The position as a vector.

Return type:

[number, number, number]

Game Scenes:

Flight, Editor Vab, Editor Sph

Note

This is a fixed position in the part, defined by the parts model. It s not necessarily the same as the parts center of mass. Use SpaceCenter.Part.centerOfMass() to get the parts center of mass.

Part.centerOfMass(referenceFrame)#

The position of the parts center of mass in the given reference frame. If the part is physicsless in flight, this is equivalent to SpaceCenter.Part.position().

Arguments:

  • referenceFrame (SpaceCenter.ReferenceFrame) – The reference frame that the returned position vector is in.

Returns:

The position as a vector.

Return type:

[number, number, number]

Game Scenes:

Flight, Editor Vab, Editor Sph

Part.boundingBox(referenceFrame)#

The axis-aligned bounding box of the part in the given reference frame.

Arguments:

  • referenceFrame (SpaceCenter.ReferenceFrame) – The reference frame that the returned position vectors are in.

Returns:

The positions of the minimum and maximum vertices of the box.

Return type:

SpaceCenter.BoundingBox

Game Scenes:

Flight, Editor Vab, Editor Sph

Note

This is computed from the meshes that make up the parts model, and covers only this part - the models of any child parts are excluded. If the part has no visible model, the box has zero volume and is centered on the SpaceCenter.Part.centerOfMass() of the part.

Part.direction(referenceFrame)#

The direction the part points in, in the given reference frame.

Return type:

[number, number, number]

Flight, Editor Vab, Editor Sph

Returns:

The velocity as a vector. The vector points in the direction of travel, and its magnitude is the speed of the body in \(\mathrm{m/s}\).

Return type:

[number, number, number]

Game Scenes:

Flight

Part.getReferenceFrame()#

The reference frame that is fixed relative to this part, and centered on a fixed position within the part, defined by the parts model.

  • The origin is at the position of the part, as returned by SpaceCenter.Part.position().

  • The axes rotate with the part.

  • The x, y and z axis directions depend on the design of the part.

Property:

Read-only, cannot be set

Return type:

SpaceCenter.ReferenceFrame

Game Scenes:

Flight, Editor Vab, Editor Sph

Note

For docking port parts, this reference frame is not necessarily equivalent to the reference frame for the docking port, returned by SpaceCenter.DockingPort.getReferenceFrame().

Part.getCenterOfMassReferenceFrame()#

The reference frame that is fixed relative to this part, and centered on its center of mass.

  • The origin is at the center of mass of the part, as returned by SpaceCenter.Part.centerOfMass().

  • The axes rotate with the part.

  • The x, y and z axis directions depend on the design of the part.

Property:

Read-only, cannot be set

Return type:

SpaceCenter.ReferenceFrame

Game Scenes:

Flight, Editor Vab, Editor Sph

Note

For docking port parts, this reference frame is not necessarily equivalent to the reference frame for the docking port, returned by SpaceCenter.DockingPort.getReferenceFrame().

Part.addForce(force, position, referenceFrame)#

Warning

Deprecated. Use Debug.AddForce instead.

Exert a constant force on the part, acting at the given position.

Arguments:

  • force ([number, number, number]) – A vector pointing in the direction that the force acts, with its magnitude equal to the strength of the force in Newtons.

  • position ([number, number, number]) – The position at which the force acts, as a vector.

  • referenceFrame (SpaceCenter.ReferenceFrame) – The reference frame that the force and position are in.

Returns:

An object that can be used to remove or modify the force.

Return type:

SpaceCenter.Force

Game Scenes:

Flight

Note

The force is removed when the client that added it disconnects.

Part.instantaneousForce(force, position, referenceFrame)#

Warning

Deprecated. Use Debug.InstantaneousForce instead.

Exert an instantaneous force on the part, acting at the given position.

Arguments:

  • force ([number, number, number]) – A vector pointing in the direction that the force acts, with its magnitude equal to the strength of the force in Newtons.

  • position ([number, number, number]) – The position at which the force acts, as a vector.

  • referenceFrame (SpaceCenter.ReferenceFrame) – The reference frame that the force and position are in.

Game Scenes:

Flight

Note

The force is applied instantaneously in a single physics update.

Whether the part is a fuel tank managed by RealFuels. The remaining properties in this section are only available when it is.

Property:

Read-only, cannot be set

boolean

Part.getHighlyPressurized()#

Whether the tank is highly pressurized, which is what a pressure-fed engine needs to draw from (see SpaceCenter.Engine.getPressureFed()). Throws an exception if the part is not a RealFuels fuel tank (see SpaceCenter.Part.getHasRealFuelsTank()).

Property:

Read-only, cannot be set

Return type:

boolean

Note

Requires RealFuels.

Part.getBoiloffRate()#

The rate at which the tank’s cryogenic contents are boiling off, in kilograms per second of in-game time, measured over the last update RealFuels computed it in. The contents keep boiling off under time warp, where that update covers a much longer span of in-game time than a physics frame does. The rate is zero for a tank holding nothing cryogenic, for one still being fed by a launch clamp, whose temperature RealFuels holds down instead, and in the editor. Throws an exception if the part is not a RealFuels fuel tank (see SpaceCenter.Part.getHasRealFuelsTank()).

Property:

Read-only, cannot be set

Return type:

number

Note

Requires RealFuels.

Module#

class SpaceCenter.Module()#

This can be used to interact with a specific part module. This includes part modules in stock KSP, and those added by mods.

In KSP, each part has zero or more PartModules associated with it. Each one contains some of the functionality of the part. For example, an engine has a “ModuleEngines” part module that contains all the functionality of an engine.

Module.getName()#

Name of the PartModule. For example, “ModuleEngines”.

Property:

Read-only, cannot be set

Return type:

string

Module.getPart()#

The part that contains this module.

Property:

Read-only, cannot be set

Return type:

SpaceCenter.Part

Module.getConfig()#

The static configuration of the module, as found in the part’s cfg file. This provides access to data that is not exposed as a field, such as the resources produced by a generator. Returns null if the module’s configuration node cannot be found.

Property:

Read-only, cannot be set

Return type:

SpaceCenter.ConfigNode

Module.getFieldList()#

A list of all the fields of the module, including those not visible in the right-click menu of the part. Filter by SpaceCenter.PartField.getVisible() to get just the visible ones.

Property:

Read-only, cannot be set

Return type:

Array of SpaceCenter.PartField

Module.getEventList()#

A list of all the events of the module, including those not currently visible or active. Events are the clickable buttons visible in the right-click menu of the part. Filter by SpaceCenter.PartEvent.getVisible() and SpaceCenter.PartEvent.getActive() to get just the ones shown in the menu.

Property:

Read-only, cannot be set

Return type:

Array of SpaceCenter.PartEvent

Module.getActionList()#

A list of all the actions of the module. These are the parts actions that can be assigned to action groups in the in-game editor.

Property:

Read-only, cannot be set

Return type:

Array of SpaceCenter.PartAction

A field of a part module. Obtained by calling SpaceCenter.Module.getFieldList().

string

PartField.getGuiName()#

The name of the field, as displayed in the right-click menu of the part. This may be empty for fields that are not visible in the menu.

Read-only, cannot be set

Return type:

string

PartField.getVisible()#

Whether the field is visible in the right-click menu of the part, in the current scene (flight or editor).

boolean

PartField.getType()#

The type of the field.

Property:

Read-only, cannot be set

Return type:

SpaceCenter.FieldType

PartField.getValue()#
PartField.setValue(value)#

The value of the field, as a string. This works for fields of any type, and returns the same string that is shown in the right-click menu of the part.

Property:

Can be read or written

Return type:

string

Note

Setting the value using this property is only permitted for string fields. Use the typed properties (SpaceCenter.PartField.getBoolValue(), SpaceCenter.PartField.getIntValue(), SpaceCenter.PartField.getFloatValue(), SpaceCenter.PartField.getDoubleValue()) to set fields of other types.

PartField.getBoolValue()#
PartField.setBoolValue(value)#

The value of a boolean field.

Can be read or written

boolean

Note

The getter throws an exception if the field is not a boolean field (see SpaceCenter.PartField.getType()).

PartField.getIntValue()#
PartField.setIntValue(value)#

The value of an integer field.

Property:

Can be read or written

Return type:

number

Note

The getter throws an exception if the field is not an integer field (see SpaceCenter.PartField.getType()).

PartField.getFloatValue()#
PartField.setFloatValue(value)#

The value of a single precision floating point field.

Property:

Can be read or written

number

Note

PartField.getDoubleValue()#
PartField.setDoubleValue(value)#

The value of a double precision floating point field.

Property:

Can be read or written

Return type:

number

Note

The getter throws an exception if the field is not a double precision floating point field (see SpaceCenter.PartField.getType()).

PartField.reset()#

Set the value of the field to its original value.

Note

The original value is the value the field had when the part was loaded. Works for any field, including those not visible in the right-click menu.

class SpaceCenter.FieldType()#

The type of a part module field. See SpaceCenter.PartField.getType().

FieldType.boolean#

A boolean field. Access using SpaceCenter.PartField.getBoolValue().

FieldType.integer#

An integer field. Access using SpaceCenter.PartField.getIntValue().

FieldType.float#

A single precision floating point field. Access using SpaceCenter.PartField.getFloatValue().

FieldType.double#

A double precision floating point field. Access using SpaceCenter.PartField.getDoubleValue().

FieldType.string#

A string field. Access using SpaceCenter.PartField.getValue().

FieldType.unknown#

A field whose type is not one of the above. Its value can still be read as a string using SpaceCenter.PartField.getValue().

Config Node#

class SpaceCenter.ConfigNode()#

Represents a configuration node, as found in a part’s configuration file. A node has a name, a set of named values and a set of child nodes. This is used to access the static configuration of a part or part module, for example via SpaceCenter.Part.getConfig() and SpaceCenter.Module.getConfig().

ConfigNode.getName()#

The name of the configuration node. For example “MODULE”.

Property:

Read-only, cannot be set

Return type:

string

ConfigNode.getValues()#

The values stored in the node, as a dictionary mapping names to values.

Property:

Read-only, cannot be set

Return type:

Map from string to string

Note

If a name appears more than once, only the first value is included. Use SpaceCenter.ConfigNode.findValues() to get all of the values with a given name.

ConfigNode.hasValue(name)#

Returns true if the node has a value with the given name.

Arguments:

  • name (string) – Name of the value.

Return type:

boolean

ConfigNode.getValue(name)#

Returns the value with the given name. If there is more than one value with the given name, the first is returned. Throws an exception if there is no value with the given name.

Arguments:

  • name (string) – Name of the value.

Return type:

string

ConfigNode.findValues(name)#

Returns all of the values with the given name, as a list.

Arguments:

  • name (string) – Name of the values.

Return type:

Array of string

ConfigNode.getNodes()#

The child nodes contained in this node.

Property:

Read-only, cannot be set

Return type:

Array of SpaceCenter.ConfigNode

ConfigNode.hasNode(name)#

Returns true if the node has a child node with the given name.

Arguments:

  • name (string) – Name of the child node.

Return type:

boolean

ConfigNode.getNode(name)#

Returns the child node with the given name. If there is more than one child node with the given name, the first is returned. Throws an exception if there is no child node with the given name.

Arguments:

  • name (string) – Name of the child node.

Return type:

SpaceCenter.ConfigNode

ConfigNode.findNodes(name)#

Returns all of the child nodes with the given name, as a list.

Arguments:

  • name (string) – Name of the child nodes.

Return type:

Array of SpaceCenter.ConfigNode

  • Robotic Rotation

  • Wheel

class SpaceCenter.AntennaTargetMode()#

The kind of target a RealAntennas antenna points at. See SpaceCenter.Antenna.getTargetMode().

AntennaTargetMode.none#

The antenna has no target. Omnidirectional antennas have none.

AntennaTargetMode.vessel#

A vessel. See SpaceCenter.Antenna.getTargetVessel().

AntennaTargetMode.body#

The center of a body. See SpaceCenter.Antenna.getTargetBody().

AntennaTargetMode.position#

A position on or above a body. See SpaceCenter.Antenna.setTargetPosition().

AntennaTargetMode.azimuthElevation#

An azimuth and elevation from the vessel’s position. See SpaceCenter.Antenna.setTargetAzimuthElevation().

AntennaTargetMode.orbitRelative#

A direction relative to the vessel’s orbital velocity. See SpaceCenter.Antenna.setTargetOrbitRelative().

Applied when SpaceCenter.ControlSurface.getDeployed() is true, and clamped to the range given by SpaceCenter.ControlSurface.getMinDeployAngle() and SpaceCenter.ControlSurface.getMaxDeployAngle(). While SpaceCenter.ControlSurface.getDeflectionOverride() is enabled, SpaceCenter.ControlSurface.getDeflection() drives the angle. A value set here takes effect when the override is released.

ControlSurface.getDeflectionOverride()#
ControlSurface.setDeflectionOverride(value)#

Whether the control surface deflection is being set directly, bypassing the vessel’s normal flight control. When enabled, the surface holds the deflection set by SpaceCenter.ControlSurface.getDeflection() instead of responding to pitch, yaw and roll control inputs. The prior state is restored when the override is released, when the controlling client disconnects, or when the vessel changes.

Property:

Can be read or written

boolean

Deployable State#

The deployment state shared by antennas, cargo bays, landing legs, radiators, resource harvesters, solar panels and wheels.

class SpaceCenter.DeployableState()#

The state of a deployable part. SpaceCenter.Antenna.getState(), SpaceCenter.CargoBay.getState(), SpaceCenter.Leg.getState(), SpaceCenter.Radiator.getState(), SpaceCenter.ResourceHarvester.getState(), SpaceCenter.SolarPanel.getState(), SpaceCenter.Wheel.getState()

DeployableState.deployed#

The part is fully deployed. A cargo bay in this state is fully open. Parts that cannot be retracted, such as fixed radiators, solar panels, antennas, landing legs and wheels, are always in this state.

DeployableState.retracted#

The part is fully retracted. A cargo bay in this state is closed and locked.

DeployableState.deploying#

The part is being deployed. A cargo bay in this state is opening.

DeployableState.retracting#

The part is being retracted. A cargo bay in this state is closing.

DeployableState.broken#

The part is broken. Cargo bays and resource harvesters never report this state, as the game does not track damage for them.

The direction that docking port points in, in the given reference frame.

Arguments:

Game Scenes:

DockingPort.rotation(referenceFrame)#

The rotation of the docking port, in the given reference frame.

Arguments:

  • referenceFrame (SpaceCenter.ReferenceFrame) – The reference frame that the returned rotation is in.

Returns:

The rotation as a quaternion of the form (x, y, z, w).

Return type:

[number, number, number, number]

Game Scenes:

Flight

DockingPort.getReferenceFrame()#

The reference frame that is fixed relative to this docking port, and oriented with the port.

  • The origin is at the position of the docking port.

  • The axes rotate with the docking port.

  • The x-axis points out to the right side of the docking port.

  • The y-axis points in the direction the docking port is facing.

  • The z-axis points out of the bottom off the docking port.

Property:

Read-only, cannot be set

Return type:

SpaceCenter.ReferenceFrame

Game Scenes:

Flight

Note

This reference frame is not necessarily equivalent to the reference frame for the part, returned by SpaceCenter.Part.getReferenceFrame().

class SpaceCenter.DockingPortState()#

The state of a docking port. See SpaceCenter.DockingPort.getState().

DockingPortState.ready#

The docking port is ready to dock to another docking port.

DockingPortState.docked#

The docking port is docked to another docking port, or docked to another part (from the VAB/SPH).

DockingPortState.docking#

The docking port is very close to another docking port, but has not docked. It is using magnetic force to acquire a solid dock.

DockingPortState.undocking#

The docking port has just been undocked from another docking port, and is disabled until it moves away by a sufficient distance (SpaceCenter.DockingPort.getReengageDistance()).

DockingPortState.shielded#

The docking port has a shield, and the shield is closed.

DockingPortState.moving#

The docking ports shield is currently opening/closing.

Engine#

class SpaceCenter.Engine()#

An engine, including ones of various types. For example liquid fuelled gimballed engines, solid rocket boosters and jet engines. Obtained by calling SpaceCenter.Part.getEngine().

Note

For RCS thrusters SpaceCenter.Part.getRCS().

The part object for this engine.

Property:

Read-only, cannot be set

Return type:

SpaceCenter.Part

Game Scenes:

Flight, Editor Vab, Editor Sph

Engine.getActive()#
Engine.setActive(value)#

Whether the engine is active. Setting this attribute may have no effect, depending on SpaceCenter.Engine.getCanShutdown() and SpaceCenter.Engine.getCanRestart().

Property:

Can be read or written

Return type:

boolean

Game Scenes:

Flight

Engine.getThrust()#

The current amount of thrust being produced by the engine, in Newtons.

Property:

Read-only, cannot be set

Return type:

number

Game Scenes:

Flight

Engine.getAvailableThrust()#

The amount of thrust, in Newtons, that would be produced by the engine when activated and with its throttle set to 100%. Returns zero if the engine does not have any fuel. Takes the engine’s current SpaceCenter.Engine.getThrustLimit() and atmospheric conditions into account.

Property:

Read-only, cannot be set

Return type:

number

Game Scenes:

Flight

Engine.availableThrustAt(pressure)#

The amount of thrust, in Newtons, that would be produced by the engine when activated and with its throttle set to 100%. Returns zero if the engine does not have any fuel. Takes the given pressure into account.

Return type:

number

Game Scenes:

Flight

Engine.getMaxThrust()#

The amount of thrust, in Newtons, that would be produced by the engine when activated and fueled, with its throttle and throttle limiter set to 100%.

Property:

Read-only, cannot be set

Return type:

number

Game Scenes:

Flight

Engine.maxThrustAt(pressure)#

The amount of thrust, in Newtons, that would be produced by the engine when activated and fueled, with its throttle and throttle limiter set to 100%. Takes the given pressure into account.

Arguments:

  • pressure (number) – Atmospheric pressure in atmospheres

Return type:

number

Game Scenes:

Flight, Editor Vab, Editor Sph

Engine.getMaxVacuumThrust()#

The maximum amount of thrust that can be produced by the engine in a vacuum, in Newtons. This is the amount of thrust produced by the engine when activated, SpaceCenter.Engine.getThrustLimit() is set to 100%, the main vessel’s throttle is set to 100% and the engine is in a vacuum.

Property:

Read-only, cannot be set

Return type:

number

Game Scenes:

Flight, Editor Vab, Editor Sph

Engine.getThrustLimit()#
Engine.setThrustLimit(value)#

The thrust limiter of the engine. A value between 0 and 1. Setting this attribute may have no effect, for example the thrust limit for a solid rocket booster cannot be changed in flight.

Property:

Can be read or written

Return type:

number

Game Scenes:

Flight, Editor Vab, Editor Sph

Engine.getThrusters()#

The components of the engine that generate thrust.

Property:

Read-only, cannot be set

Return type:

Array of SpaceCenter.Thruster

Game Scenes:

Flight

Note

For example, this corresponds to the rocket nozzel on a solid rocket booster, or the individual nozzels on a RAPIER engine. The overall thrust produced by the engine, as reported by SpaceCenter.Engine.getAvailableThrust(), SpaceCenter.Engine.getMaxThrust() and others, is the sum of the thrust generated by each thruster.

Engine.getGimbalLocked()#
Engine.setGimbalLocked(value)#

Whether the engines gimbal is locked in place. Setting this attribute has no effect if the engine is not gimballed.

Property:

Can be read or written

Return type:

boolean

Game Scenes:

Flight, Editor Vab, Editor Sph

Engine.getGimbalLimit()#
Engine.setGimbalLimit(value)#

The gimbal limiter of the engine. A value between 0 and 1. Returns 0 if the gimbal is locked.

Property:

Can be read or written

Return type:

number

Game Scenes:

Flight, Editor Vab, Editor Sph

Engine.getGimbalResponseSpeedEnabled()#

Whether the gimbal moves toward its commanded deflection at SpaceCenter.Engine.getGimbalResponseSpeed(). When false, the gimbal reaches its commanded deflection in one physics tick. Throws an exception if the engine is not gimballed.

Property:

Read-only, cannot be set

Return type:

boolean

Game Scenes:

Flight, Editor Vab, Editor Sph

Engine.getGimbalResponseSpeed()#

The response speed of the gimbal, in \(\mathrm{s^{-1}}\). Throws an exception if the engine is not gimballed.

Property:

Read-only, cannot be set

Return type:

number

Game Scenes:

Flight, Editor Vab, Editor Sph

Note

Each physics tick of length \(\Delta t\), the gimbal moves a fraction \(v \Delta t\) of the way from its deflection to the commanded deflection, where \(v\) is the response speed. The fraction is at most 1, so at high physics warp the gimbal can reach its commanded deflection in one tick. This lag only applies when SpaceCenter.Engine.getGimbalResponseSpeedEnabled() is true.

Engine.getGimbalPitchEnabled()#
Engine.setGimbalPitchEnabled(value)#

Whether the gimbal responds to pitch control input. Throws an exception if the engine is not gimballed.

Property:

Can be read or written

Return type:

boolean

Game Scenes:

Flight, Editor Vab, Editor Sph

Engine.getGimbalYawEnabled()#
Engine.setGimbalYawEnabled(value)#

Whether the gimbal responds to yaw control input. Throws an exception if the engine is not gimballed.

Property:

Can be read or written

Return type:

boolean

Game Scenes:

Flight, Editor Vab, Editor Sph

Engine.getGimbalRollEnabled()#
Engine.setGimbalRollEnabled(value)#

Whether the gimbal responds to roll control input. Throws an exception if the engine is not gimballed.

Property:

Can be read or written

Return type:

boolean

Game Scenes:

Flight, Editor Vab, Editor Sph

Engine.getGimbalOverride()#
Engine.setGimbalOverride(value)#

Whether the gimbal is being controlled directly, bypassing the vessel’s normal flight controls. When enabled, the gimbal deflection is set by SpaceCenter.Engine.getGimbalActuation() instead of the normal control inputs. The override is automatically released if the controlling client disconnects or the vessel changes. Has no effect if the engine is not gimballed.

Property:

Can be read or written

Return type:

boolean

Game Scenes:

Flight

Engine.getGimbalActuation()#
Engine.setGimbalActuation(value)#

The gimbal actuation command applied when SpaceCenter.Engine.getGimbalOverride() is enabled, in the pitch, roll and yaw axes. Each component is a normalized control input between -1 and 1. The physical deflection is scaled by SpaceCenter.Engine.getGimbalRange() and SpaceCenter.Engine.getGimbalLimit(). When the gimbal is not being overridden, returns the current actuation.

Property:

Can be read or written

Return type:

[number, number, number]

Game Scenes:

Flight

Note

The gimbal ignores the component for an axis it is disabled for, such as pitch when SpaceCenter.Engine.getGimbalPitchEnabled() is false.

Engine.getAvailableTorque()#

The available torque, in \(\mathrm{N \cdot m}\), that can be produced by this engine, in the positive and negative pitch, roll and yaw axes of the vessel. These axes correspond to the coordinate axes of the SpaceCenter.Vessel.getReferenceFrame(). Returns zero if the engine is inactive, or not gimballed.

Property:

Read-only, cannot be set

Return type:

SpaceCenter.AxisRange

Game Scenes:

Flight

Note

The torque is zero about an axis the gimbal is disabled for, such as pitch when SpaceCenter.Engine.getGimbalPitchEnabled() is false.

Engine.getCanReverseThrust()#

Whether the engine has a recognized thrust reverser. This is true for stock engines with a thrust reverser (such as the J-33 “Wheesley” and J-90 “Goliath” turbofan engines) and for supported mod engines. It is false for engines whose reverser is not recognized, as KSP provides no standard way to detect one.

Property:

Read-only, cannot be set

Return type:

boolean

Game Scenes:

Flight, Editor Vab, Editor Sph

Note

Recognizes the thrust reversers of Firespitter and KerbalActuators.

Engine.getThrustReversed()#
Engine.setThrustReversed(value)#

Whether the engine’s thrust reverser is engaged, reversing the direction of thrust. While the reverser is still moving, this reports the state it is moving to, so a read immediately after a set returns the value that was set and setting the same value again has no effect. Throws an exception if the engine does not have a thrust reverser (see SpaceCenter.Engine.getCanReverseThrust()).

Property:

Can be read or written

Return type:

boolean

Game Scenes:

Flight

Engine.toggleThrustReversal()#

Toggle the engine’s thrust reverser. Throws an exception if the engine does not have a thrust reverser (see SpaceCenter.Engine.getCanReverseThrust()).

Game Scenes:

Flight

Engine.getHasRealFuels()#

Whether the engine is managed by RealFuels. The remaining properties in this section are only available when it is.

Property:

Read-only, cannot be set

Return type:

boolean

Game Scenes:

Flight, Editor Vab, Editor Sph

Engine.getIgnitions()#

The number of times the engine can still be ignited, or -1 if it can be ignited an unlimited number of times. Throws an exception if the engine is not managed by RealFuels (see SpaceCenter.Engine.getHasRealFuels()).

Property:

Read-only, cannot be set

Return type:

number

Game Scenes:

Flight, Editor Vab, Editor Sph

Note

Requires RealFuels.

Engine.getIgnitionResources()#

The resources the engine consumes each time it ignites, keyed by resource name, with the amount of each that is required. The engine uses up an ignition and fails to light if they are not available. Throws an exception if the engine is not managed by RealFuels (see SpaceCenter.Engine.getHasRealFuels()).

Property:

Read-only, cannot be set

Return type:

Map from string to number

Game Scenes:

Flight, Editor Vab, Editor Sph

Note

Requires RealFuels.

Engine.getHasUllage()#

Whether the engine’s propellant is subject to ullage, so that it must be settled before the engine will run reliably. Throws an exception if the engine is not managed by RealFuels (see SpaceCenter.Engine.getHasRealFuels()).

Property:

Read-only, cannot be set

Return type:

boolean

Game Scenes:

Flight, Editor Vab, Editor Sph

Note

Requires RealFuels.

Engine.getPropellantStability()#

How settled the propellant feeding the engine is, from 0 (fully unsettled) to 1 (fully settled). Acceleration along the engine’s thrust axis settles it, and coasting and rotation unsettle it. Throws an exception if the engine is not managed by RealFuels (see SpaceCenter.Engine.getHasRealFuels()).

Property:

Read-only, cannot be set

Return type:

number

Game Scenes:

Flight

Note

Requires RealFuels.

Engine.getPropellantReliability()#

The probability that the propellant feeding the engine behaves normally, from 0 to 1. This is SpaceCenter.Engine.getPropellantStability() scaled by the game’s ullage difficulty setting, and is the value RealFuels itself tests against when deciding whether the engine runs. Throws an exception if the engine is not managed by RealFuels (see SpaceCenter.Engine.getHasRealFuels()).

Property:

Read-only, cannot be set

Return type:

number

Game Scenes:

Flight

Note

Requires RealFuels.

Engine.getPressureFed()#

Whether the engine is fed by tank pressure rather than by a pump, and so needs to draw from a highly pressurized tank. Throws an exception if the engine is not managed by RealFuels (see SpaceCenter.Engine.getHasRealFuels()).

Property:

Read-only, cannot be set

Return type:

boolean

Game Scenes:

Flight, Editor Vab, Editor Sph

Note

Requires RealFuels.

Engine.getHasFeedPressure()#

Whether the tanks feeding the engine supply the pressure it needs. Always true for an engine that is not pressure fed. Throws an exception if the engine is not managed by RealFuels (see SpaceCenter.Engine.getHasRealFuels()).

Property:

Read-only, cannot be set

Return type:

boolean

Game Scenes:

Flight

Note

Requires RealFuels.

class SpaceCenter.ScienceSubject(fields)#

Obtained by calling SpaceCenter.Experiment.getScienceSubject().

ScienceSubject.id#

The identifier of the subject, e.g. crewReport@KerbinSrfLandedLaunchPad.

Type:

string

ScienceSubject.title#

The title of the subject, as shown in the science archives.

Type:

string

ScienceSubject.isComplete#

Whether the subject has been fully researched. This is true once the science banked for the subject reaches the science cap. As the banked science (see SpaceCenter.ScienceSubject.science) is only updated after transmission/recovery, this reflects fully mining the subject over repeated experiments, not whether a single run has produced data. To check whether a run has produced data, and how valuable it is, use SpaceCenter.Experiment.getHasData() and SpaceCenter.ScienceData.transmitValue.

Type:

boolean

ScienceSubject.science#

Amount of science already earned from this subject, not updated until after transmission/recovery.

Type:

number

ScienceSubject.scienceCap#

Total science allowable for this subject.

Type:

number

ScienceSubject.dataScale#

Multiply science value by this to determine data amount in mits.

Type:

number

ScienceSubject.subjectValue#

Multiplier for specific Celestial Body/Experiment Situation combination.

Type:

number

ScienceSubject.scientificValue#

Diminishing value multiplier for decreasing the science value returned from repeated experiments.

Type:

number

The rise in SpaceCenter.Leg.getLoad() over one physics tick that breaks the leg, in \(\mathrm{kN}\). Throws an exception if the leg is not breakable.

class SpaceCenter.ParachuteState()#

The state of a parachute. See SpaceCenter.Parachute.getState().

ParachuteState.stowed#

The parachute is safely tucked away inside its housing.

ParachuteState.armed#

The parachute is armed for deployment.

ParachuteState.semiDeployed#

The parachute has been deployed and is providing some drag, but is not fully deployed yet. (Stock parachutes only)

ParachuteState.deployed#

The parachute is fully deployed.

ParachuteState.cut#

The parachute has been cut.

class SpaceCenter.ParachuteSafeState()#

The safety state of deploying a parachute. See SpaceCenter.Parachute.getSafeState().

ParachuteSafeState.safe#

The parachute is safe to deploy.

ParachuteSafeState.risky#

Deploying the parachute is risky, and it may break off.

ParachuteSafeState.unsafe#

The parachute is unsafe to deploy, and will break off.

ParachuteSafeState.none#

The safety state is not available, because the vessel is not in an atmosphere or the parachute has already been deployed or cut.

class SpaceCenter.RCS()#

RCS.getActive()#

Whether the RCS thrusters are active. An RCS thruster is inactive if the RCS action group is disabled (SpaceCenter.Control.getRCS()), the RCS thruster itself is not enabled (SpaceCenter.RCS.getEnabled()), or it is covered by a fairing (SpaceCenter.Part.getShielded()) and cannot thrust while shielded.

Property:

Read-only, cannot be set

boolean

RCS.getYawEnabled()#
RCS.setYawEnabled(value)#

boolean

Flight, Editor Vab, Editor Sph

RCS.getForwardEnabled()#
RCS.setForwardEnabled(value)#

Property:

Can be read or written

boolean

Game Scenes:

Flight, Editor Vab, Editor Sph

RCS.getUpEnabled()#
RCS.setUpEnabled(value)#

Whether the RCS thruster will fire when up control input is given.

Property:

Can be read or written

Return type:

boolean

Game Scenes:

Flight, Editor Vab, Editor Sph

RCS.getRightEnabled()#
RCS.setRightEnabled(value)#

Whether the RCS thruster will fire when right control input is given.

Property:

Can be read or written

Return type:

boolean

Game Scenes:

Flight, Editor Vab, Editor Sph

RCS.getInputOverride()#
RCS.setInputOverride(value)#

Whether the RCS control is being set directly, bypassing the vessel’s normal flight controls. When enabled, the rotation and translation demand is set by SpaceCenter.RCS.getRotationOverride() and SpaceCenter.RCS.getTranslationOverride() instead of the normal control inputs. The override is automatically released if the controlling client disconnects or the vessel changes. Precision mode leaves an overridden block at full thrust.

Property:

Can be read or written

Return type:

boolean

Game Scenes:

Flight

RCS.getRotationOverride()#
RCS.setRotationOverride(value)#

The rotation demand applied when SpaceCenter.RCS.getInputOverride() is enabled, in the pitch, roll and yaw axes. Each component is a normalized control input between -1 and 1.

Property:

Can be read or written

Return type:

[number, number, number]

Game Scenes:

Flight

Note

The block ignores the component for an axis it is disabled for, such as pitch when SpaceCenter.RCS.getPitchEnabled() is false.

RCS.getTranslationOverride()#
RCS.setTranslationOverride(value)#

The translation demand applied when SpaceCenter.RCS.getInputOverride() is enabled, in the right, up and forward axes. Each component is a normalized control input between -1 and 1.

Property:

Can be read or written

Return type:

[number, number, number]

Game Scenes:

Flight

Note

The block ignores the component for an axis it is disabled for, such as right when SpaceCenter.RCS.getRightEnabled() is false.

RCS.getAvailableTorque()#

The available torque, in \(\mathrm{N \cdot m}\), that can be produced by this RCS, in the positive and negative pitch, roll and yaw axes of the vessel. These axes correspond to the coordinate axes of the SpaceCenter.Vessel.getReferenceFrame(). Returns zero if RCS is disable.

Property:

Read-only, cannot be set

Return type:

SpaceCenter.AxisRange

Game Scenes:

Flight

Note

Precision mode weakens the block, and the available torque follows it. A block driven by SpaceCenter.RCS.getInputOverride() is exempt, so SpaceCenter.RCS.overrideWrench() can report the larger torque an override reaches.

RCS.getAvailableForce()#

The available force, in Newtons, that can be produced by this RCS, in the positive and negative x, y and z axes of the vessel. These axes correspond to the coordinate axes of the SpaceCenter.Vessel.getReferenceFrame(). Returns zero if RCS is disabled.

Property:

Read-only, cannot be set

Return type:

SpaceCenter.AxisRange

Game Scenes:

Flight

Note

Precision mode weakens the block, and the available force follows it. A block driven by SpaceCenter.RCS.getInputOverride() is exempt, so SpaceCenter.RCS.overrideWrench() can report the larger force an override reaches.

RCS.getForce()#

The force being applied by the RCS thrusters, in Newtons. The vector is in the vessel’s reference frame (SpaceCenter.Vessel.getReferenceFrame()). Returns zero if the RCS is inactive.

Property:

Read-only, cannot be set

Return type:

[number, number, number]

Game Scenes:

Flight

RCS.getTorque()#

The torque being applied by the RCS thrusters about the vessel’s center of mass, in \(\mathrm{N \cdot m}\). The vector is in the vessel’s reference frame (SpaceCenter.Vessel.getReferenceFrame()). Returns zero if the RCS is inactive.

Property:

Read-only, cannot be set

Return type:

[number, number, number]

Game Scenes:

Flight

RCS.overrideWrench(rotation, translation)#

The force and torque the given demands would produce, in Newtons and \(\mathrm{N \cdot m}\).

Arguments:

  • rotation ([number, number, number]) – A rotation demand, as set by SpaceCenter.RCS.getRotationOverride().

  • translation ([number, number, number]) – A translation demand, as set by SpaceCenter.RCS.getTranslationOverride().

Returns:

The force, and the torque about the vessel’s center of mass, in the vessel’s reference frame (SpaceCenter.Vessel.getReferenceFrame()), or zero if the RCS is inactive.

Return type:

SpaceCenter.Wrench

Game Scenes:

Flight

Note

The demands do not have to be applied. The prediction leaves out full thrust, which SpaceCenter.RCS.getForce() and SpaceCenter.RCS.getTorque() include.

RCS.getAvailableThrust()#

The amount of thrust, in Newtons, that would be produced by the thruster when activated. Returns zero if the thruster does not have any fuel. Takes the thrusters current SpaceCenter.RCS.getThrustLimit() and atmospheric conditions into account.

Property:

Read-only, cannot be set

Return type:

number

Game Scenes:

Flight

RCS.getMaxThrust()#

The maximum amount of thrust that can be produced by the RCS thrusters when active, in Newtons, with the SpaceCenter.RCS.getThrustLimit() set to 100%. Takes atmospheric conditions into account.

Property:

Read-only, cannot be set

Return type:

number

Game Scenes:

Flight

RCS.getMaxVacuumThrust()#

The maximum amount of thrust that can be produced by the RCS thrusters when active in a vacuum, in Newtons.

Property:

Read-only, cannot be set

Return type:

number

Game Scenes:

Flight, Editor Vab, Editor Sph

RCS.getThrustLimit()#

Sensor.getValue()#

The current value of the sensor.

Property:

Read-only, cannot be set

Return type:

string

Game Scenes:

Flight

Note

This is the same readout string shown in the part’s right-click menu in-game, and is intended for display rather than for parsing. Both its units and the way it formats numbers follow the language the game is running in, so it is not stable across locales. For programmatic access to the underlying quantities, use SpaceCenter.Part.getTemperature() (temperature sensors), SpaceCenter.Flight.getGForce() (accelerometers) or SpaceCenter.Flight.getStaticPressure() (barometers).

Thruster#

class SpaceCenter.Thruster()#

The component of an SpaceCenter.Engine or SpaceCenter.RCS part that generates thrust. Can obtained by calling SpaceCenter.Engine.getThrusters() or SpaceCenter.RCS.getThrusters().

Note

Engines can consist of multiple thrusters. For example, the S3 KS-25x4 “Mammoth” has four rocket nozzels, and so consists of four thrusters.

Thruster.getPart()#

The SpaceCenter.Thruster.getPart() that contains this thruster.

Property:

Read-only, cannot be set

Return type:

SpaceCenter.Part

Game Scenes:

Flight

Thruster.getThrust()#

The thrust being produced by the thruster, in Newtons.

Property:

Read-only, cannot be set

Return type:

number

Game Scenes:

Flight

Thruster.thrustPosition(referenceFrame)#

The position at which the thruster generates thrust, in the given reference frame. For gimballed engines, this takes into account the current rotation of the gimbal.

Arguments:

  • referenceFrame (SpaceCenter.ReferenceFrame) – The reference frame that the returned position vector is in.

Returns:

The position as a vector.

Return type:

[number, number, number]

Game Scenes:

Flight

Thruster.thrustDirection(referenceFrame)#

The direction of the force generated by the thruster, in the given reference frame. This is opposite to the direction in which the thruster expels propellant. For gimballed engines, this takes into account the current rotation of the gimbal.

Arguments:

  • referenceFrame (SpaceCenter.ReferenceFrame) – The reference frame that the returned direction is in.

Returns:

The direction as a unit vector.

Return type:

[number, number, number]

Game Scenes:

Flight

Thruster.getThrustReferenceFrame()#

A reference frame that is fixed relative to the thruster and orientated with its thrust direction (SpaceCenter.Thruster.thrustDirection()). For gimballed engines, this takes into account the current rotation of the gimbal.

  • The origin is at the position of thrust for this thruster (SpaceCenter.Thruster.thrustPosition()).

  • The axes rotate with the thrust direction. This is the direction in which the thruster expels propellant, including any gimballing.

  • The y-axis points along the thrust direction.

  • The x-axis and z-axis are perpendicular to the thrust direction.

Property:

Read-only, cannot be set

Return type:

SpaceCenter.ReferenceFrame

Game Scenes:

Flight

Thruster.getGimballed()#

Whether the thruster is gimballed.

Property:

Read-only, cannot be set

Return type:

boolean

Game Scenes:

Flight

Thruster.gimbalPosition(referenceFrame)#

Position around which the gimbal pivots.

Arguments:

  • referenceFrame (SpaceCenter.ReferenceFrame) – The reference frame that the returned position vector is in.

Returns:

The position as a vector.

Return type:

[number, number, number]

Game Scenes:

Flight

Thruster.getGimbalAngle()#

The current gimbal angle in the pitch, roll and yaw axes, in degrees.

Property:

Read-only, cannot be set

Return type:

[number, number, number]

Game Scenes:

Flight

Thruster.initialThrustPosition(referenceFrame)#

The position at which the thruster generates thrust, when the engine is in its initial position (no gimballing), in the given reference frame.

Arguments:

  • referenceFrame (SpaceCenter.ReferenceFrame) – The reference frame that the returned position vector is in.

Returns:

The position as a vector.

Return type:

[number, number, number]

Game Scenes:

Flight

Note

This position can move when the gimbal rotates. This is because the thrust position and gimbal position are not necessarily the same.

Thruster.initialThrustDirection(referenceFrame)#

The direction of the force generated by the thruster, when the engine is in its initial position (no gimballing), in the given reference frame. This is opposite to the direction in which the thruster expels propellant.

Arguments:

  • referenceFrame (SpaceCenter.ReferenceFrame) – The reference frame that the returned direction is in.

Returns:

The direction as a unit vector.

Return type:

[number, number, number]

Game Scenes:

Flight

Wheel.getSuspensionSpring()#

The spring constant of the suspension, in \(\mathrm{kN/m}\), or null while the wheel is not grounded. Throws an exception if the wheel has no suspension.

Property:

Read-only, cannot be set

Return type:

Game Scenes:

Flight

Note

The game updates it while the wheel is grounded, from SpaceCenter.Wheel.getSuspensionSpringStrength(), the vessel’s mass, the wheel’s compression and the local gravity.

Wheel.getSuspensionDamper()#

The damping constant of the suspension, in \(\mathrm{kN \cdot s/m}\), or null while the wheel is not grounded. Throws an exception if the wheel has no suspension.

Property:

Read-only, cannot be set

Return type:

number or null

Game Scenes:

Flight

Note

The game updates it while the wheel is grounded, from SpaceCenter.Wheel.getSuspensionDamperStrength() and SpaceCenter.Wheel.getSuspensionSpring().

Wheel.getSuspensionTravel()#

The travel of the suspension, in meters.

Property:

Read-only, cannot be set

Return type:

number

Game Scenes:

Flight

Wheel.getLoad()#

The force pressing the wheel into the ground, in \(\mathrm{kN}\).

Property:

Read-only, cannot be set

Return type:

number

Game Scenes:

Flight

Note

The game raises the load of a grounded wheel to at least 0.5 kN, or 10 kN for a wheel with the old friction model. SpaceCenter.Wheel.getImpactTolerance() applies to the rise in this value.

class SpaceCenter.MotorState()#

The state of the motor on a powered wheel. See SpaceCenter.Wheel.getMotorState().

The motor is idle.

MotorState.running#

The motor is running.

The motor is disabled.

The motor is inoperable.

MotorState.notEnoughResources#

The motor does not have enough resources to run.
